t: Supporting the Department of Public Works, the Mayor's Office, other City and County of San Francisco agencies, the private business sector, and community organizations to form a task force to organize a semi-annual city-wide cleanup day that will include…
Renaming Dale Place, in its entirety, "Continuum Way" in honor of Continuum HIV Day Services' innovation and dedication serving those living with HIV disease or AIDS.
